title: The 2020 Israeli Elections: A Pre-Vote Private Briefing with Professor Gabriel Weimann
channel: American Friends of University of Haifa
description: DR. GABRIEL WEIMANN is a Full Professor of Communication in the Department of Communication at University of Haifa in Israel and a Visiting Professor at the University of Maryland. His research interests include the study of media effects, political campaigns, persuasion and influence, and modern terrorism and the mass media. He has published more than 180 reports and 9 books, including Terrorism in Cyberspace: The Next Generation. He has received numerous grants and awards from international foundations and has been a Visiting Professor at various universities including, University of Pennsylvania, Stanford University, and notable others.
